headline: Continued Old Tower Hill Road form-based code to the next Town Council meeting; staff will draft farm stand ordinance.
summary: Staff updated members on talks about the form-based code for Old Tower Hill Road, including eliminating the FB1 zone. Staff will turn the comments on farm stands on agricultural uses under five acres into a draft ordinance for a future session. Rt. 1 Stewardship Plan and Harbor Management Plan were shared for information only.

decision_titles: Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Project, Form-Based Code
Road/Farm Stands ordinance for agricultural uses under five acres
plain_text:
Town of South Kingstown   
Planning Board   
Work Session Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, October 6, 2026 at 6:30 PM   
South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Maria H. Mack, Chair 
Susan Axelrod, Vice Chair 
Elizabeth Karp, Secretary 
Paul Jordan 
Armand Monaco 
Robyn Pothier 
Kaiper Wilson 
 
A. Call to Order & Roll Call: 
Ms. Mack called the meeting to order at 6:32 p.m. 
 
ROLL CALL: 
Present: Susan Axelrod, Paul Jordan, Liz Karp, Armand Monaco, Kaiper Wilson, and Maria Mack. 
Absent: Robyn Pothier 
 
Also present were:  Brian Wagner, Deputy Planning Director; Curtis Dufour, Principal Planner; and Andrew Teitz, Special 
Legal Counsel. 
 
B. Recommendations to Town Council: 
 1. Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Project, Form-Based Code: Follow up on recent Town Council meetings. 
As a result of comments received at the Town Council's Public Hearing on the FBC, Mr. Wagner updated the board on 
staff conversations; one item discussed was eliminating the FB1 zone.  Discussion ensued. The Form Based Code was 
continued to the next Town Council meeting on Tuesday, October 13, 2026. 
 
 2. Road/Farm Stands - General discussion for possible draft ordinance. 
Ms. Mack introduced the subject and referenced the Memo from Special Legal Counsel, Amy Goins. Mr. Wagner 
explained that the Town Council is requesting guidance from the Planning Board.  The subject is agricultural uses under 
five acres.  Discussion ensued. Mr. Wagner stated the referral from the Council was to the Planning Board members. 
Staff is looking for the Board to refer this to staff to put something together based on comments made during tonight's 
discussion.  Staff will organize tonight's comments into an ordinance for further consideration and comment; Ms. Mack 
directed Mr. Wagner to do so for a future work session. 
C. Reports and Special Items: 
 1. Rt. 1 Stewardship Plan - For Planning Board Information  
Mr. Wagner informed the board that the Rt. 1 Stewardship Committee has not made a final vote, and this is before the 
Board for informational use only. If the Planning Board has any comments on it, staff will relay them back to the Rt. 1 
Stewardship Committee. 
 2. Harbor Management Plan - For Planning Board Information 
 https://www.southkingstownri.gov/DocumentCenter/View/23302/2026-7-27__Final-RIDEM-Clean 
Mr. Wagner informed the Board that this was also for the Board's information only, and briefly relayed his work efforts 
on if over the last five years.  CRMC will approve it as soon as they have an "adoped" version of it from the Town 
Council, which is the next step.
D. Adjournment: 
Ms. Mack reminded the Board members of the training on Saturday, November 14, 2026; all members should have 
received the informational email from Mr. Rabbitt. 
Mr. Teitz expanded on the training — but was inaudible. 
 
Upon Motion made by Ms. Wilson, duly seconded by Ms. Karp, the meeting was adjourned at 7:13 p.m., by unanimous 
vote.
